programmes.d: Craig’s back with Ashley and he’s determined not to screw it up this time.
Eli organizes a surprise birthday party to cheer Clare up, and starts to suspect that she's hiding something.
Distraught when Ashley refuses his proposal, Craig falls into a major rage, completely trashing his hotel room.
When a group of parents try to stop the play, Eli takes action.

Degrassi has a new hottie in Grade 9 and Manny’s got her eye on him. Especially since her “boyfriend” Spinner can’t even be bothered to take a night off work to come to the Cupid Dance she’s organized.
On opening night for Romeo and Jules, Tristan is nowhere to be found.

Something’s wrong with Emma. Though she’s frustrated at being treated with kid gloves by everyone since the school shooting, she’s not sure how she’d rather be treated. So she just keeps going on, numbly reassuring everyone that she’s fine.
As Becky begins to fall for Adam, she worries how her conservative parents will react.
Emma steps into the lead role in Dracula, but her recent extra-curricular activities with Jay prove even more dramatic.
Becky doesn't want to keep Adam a secret, so she decides to tell her parents that he's transgender.
Maya is not feeling very good about herself, so she lets Tori give her a pageant-style makeover.
Spinner has difficulty dealing with the return of injured Jimmy. He hasn’t talked to him since the shooting, and his guilt over what he did leaves him unable to welcome Jimmy back to school.
Maya's friendship with Tori is tested when both girls compete in the Miss Millennial pageant.
Ellie is finding it hard to make ends meet now that she’s living on her own and hates relying on her mother for rent, especially with its obligatory dinners to pick up the cheque.
Frustrated with her heavy workload, Alli decides to have a little fun -- with or without Dave.
Paige and Matt are totally in love, so what if they have to keep it secret? It’s worth all the extra effort.
After several days without sleep, Alli crashes at the worst possible time.

With school coming to a close, Marco is making huge plans for his summer with Dylan – and their future. He’s considering fast-tracking to graduate high school, joining Dylan in university a year earlier.
At the Battle of the Bands, Adam really hits it off with Missy, another musician.

After dutifully picking up the Spirit Squad slack for a love-struck Paige all year, Manny feels betrayed when Paige claims all the glory. So Manny plots her revenge with a complicated cheer that leaves Paige with a broken leg on Prom Night.
As WhisperHug prepares for the band competition, things get messy between Adam and Missy.

Ashley’s leaving for the summer, and the idea of their temporary farewell and the stress of writing a song for Kevin Smith’s movie -- is making him, well, nuts. So Craig decides to do whatever it takes to follow her.
Drew can’t wait to tie the knot with Bianca in Vegas.
Frustrated by everything around him, Craig runs away. As he wanders the street, he befriends a young busker nicknamed, “Skinny”.
Drew can’t wait to tie the knot with Bianca in Vegas.

As Paige and Spinner awkwardly discuss last night's surprising kiss-fest, Darcy interrupts. She regrets their fight and breakup. But Spinner tells her he meant what he said – if Darcy can’t accept him, past and all, they're through.
During Spirit Week at Degrassi, everyone has something to prove.
Another year at Degrassi kicks off and Manny decides she’s going to be a serious actress, whatever it takes.
When tragedy strikes at Degrassi, everyone deals with the situation in a different way.
Haunted by Degrassi's recent tragedy, Eli invites Jake and Mo to a secret party..
Manny’s still foggy on what exactly it was that happened at Peter’s party the night before. She knows she made a pretty racy video but Peter will erase everything… or so he says.
Worried about Eli's mental state, Clare becomes overprotective.
Paige has got her whole life mapped out. She plans on being accepted into the marketing program at the best university in Canada.
After Drew moves out, there's a break-in at the loft, and Fiona fears for her safety.
JT has got his license. He’s got a steady girlfriend in Liberty, who happens to be Student Council President. So why is he feeling anything but a “man”? Because Liberty’s in control.
Fiona takes drastic measures to feel safer at home, and puts herself in danger.

After all the craziness of last year, Craig has one overriding goal: no drama. He’s focused on his friends, his family, his studies, and his band – a reconstituted Downtown Sasquatch but no Spinner - a new addition is rocking the drum-kit…
Drew can’t wait to tie the knot with Bianca in Vegas.

After proving he’s still got talent on the hardwood, Jimmy is invited to try out for the Wheelchair Basketball Association’s Junior Team. It’s Jimmy’s second chance at athletic stardom, and an opportunity to make his father proud.
Drew can’t wait to tie the knot with Bianca in Vegas.
As Liberty’s pregnancy enters its sixth month, she and JT are forced to face reality: even though no longer a couple, they have to deal with the pregnancy.

Desperate for cash, JT has stolen drugs from the pharmacy… He becomes entangled in a web between his boss, the drug dealer, and the police.

Someone’s definitely interested in Marco. But as it turns out, Tim is interested in Marco, but not for the expected reason. Tim knows Marco is gay, and has been struggling with how to come out to his friends and family.

The one-year anniversary of the school shooting is approaching and everyone’s feeling the weight of it. Not least of whom is Spinner Mason, still persona non grata.
Worried about Eli's mental state, Clare becomes overprotective.
After Drew moves out, there's a break-in at the loft, and Fiona fears for her safety.
Tonight is the premiere of “Jay and Silent Bob Go Canadian, Eh” and with many of the students and faculty on the guest list, it’s like the whole school is gripped in movie premiere fever!
Fiona takes drastic measures to feel safer at home, and puts herself in danger.

Paige wakes Alex up in her bed – Paige spent the night on the floor – and as the two girls awkwardly prepare for school, they try to avoid the elephant in the room. As in, that they KISSED last night. What happened?
Maya lets loose at a party and posts a video online, hoping it'll change her image.
Craig bursts into rehearsal with the good news – they’ve been accepted to perform at a Northern Sounds Showcase. The band is NOT so into it at first – music is Craig’s dream, not theirs.
After a stressful audition, Maya tosses her cello in the trash, and decides to have more fun.

Since being "saved" everything has been going Spinner's way: he's made a good friend in Friendship Club leader Linus; his relationship with Darcy has been going strong, and his recent interest in improving school life has been getting him noticed.
Imogen can’t imagine saying good-bye to Fiona and resorts to desperate measures to try keep them together.

Facing the pressure of year-end exams, the furthest thing from Marco’s mind is what happened a year ago – when Dylan stomped all over his heart. Marco takes this as a sign that he’s over Dylan for good.

The end of another school year finds Darcy’s faith – in her boyfriend – being put to the test. When she discovers that Spinner has a past, Darcy grapples with a harsh reality of teen romance: jealousy.
